warp: shader_body { vec2 d=uv-.5; float r=length(d),a=atan(d.y,d.x); a=abs(mod(a+.5236,1.0472)-.5236); ret=texture(sampler_main, vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*r+.5).xyz*.97; }
comp: shader_body { vec3 c=texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz; vec2 d=uv-0.5; float lattice=sin(d.x*47.0+time*0.15)*cos(d.y*41.0-time*0.11); float spores=pow(max(lattice,0.0),12.0)*0.18; vec3 pollen=vec3(c.g*1.3,c.r*1.1,c.b*.6); ret=pollen+texture(sampler_blur2, uv).xyz*vec3(.3,1.,.4)*1.2+vec3(.08,.35,.15)*spores; }
